_desc: Extended news with NPC entities, Echo discoveries, business openings, heroic acts

npc_names.desc: NPCs who can be subjects of news stories

echo_events._desc: News about Echoes - music, instruments, discoveries, reactions

headlines: ECHO SIGHTING: {npc_name} Claims to Have Heard 'Music'
Underground Reports: Echo Fragment Recovered from {location}
Ancient Device Found - Could Play Lost 'Songs'
npc_reactions_believer: I always knew Echoes were real. The music exists!
Finally, proof! The songs survived the Silence!
They can't hide the truth anymore. Echoes are everywhere!
I felt it. The resonance. It's beautiful.
The Prophet was right. The old frequencies return.
This changes everything. Music will heal us.
I've dreamed of sounds like this. Now they're real.
The Temple can't suppress this forever.
We were right to keep searching. The Echoes live!
A new era begins. The Silence ends.
npc_reactions_skeptic: Echoes? Please. It's probably just equipment malfunction.
People see what they want to see. Hear what they want to hear.
Mass hysteria. That's all this Echo nonsense is.
Temple propaganda to keep us hoping for fairy tales.
I'll believe in music when I hear it myself.
Neural glitches from cheap implants. Nothing more.
If music existed, the corporations would have found it.
Echoes are just stories we tell children.
npc_reactions_curious: What if it's true? What if music really exists?
I want to believe... but I need proof.
Has anyone actually HEARD an Echo? Really?
The stories are consistent. That's... interesting.
I'm keeping an open mind. Strange things happen.
Maybe the old world wasn't completely destroyed.
The Prophet's followers seem so certain...
I'd give anything to hear what they describe.
The longing is real, even if the Echoes aren't.

headlines: BREAKING: Public Echo Exhibition Draws Thousands
{npc_name} Becomes First to Hear 'Song' in Generation
Tears Flow as Citizens Experience Ancient 'Melody'
'Like Nothing I've Ever Known' - First Music Listeners React
Mass Emotional Response to Echo Playback Event
Musicians? New Group Claims to 'Create' Sounds
Children Exposed to Echo - Reactions Unprecedented
The Silence Breaks: First Public Music Event
npc_reactions_overwhelmed: *tears streaming* I never knew... I never knew anything could sound like that.
My whole body is shaking. Is this what we lost?
They took this from us. For generations. Why?
I can't... I can't describe it. There are no words.
It's like remembering something I never knew.
The ache in my chest... is this what 'moved' means?
How did they live without this? How do WE live without this?
I'm crying and I don't know why. I can't stop.
It speaks to something deep. Something forgotten.
We have to bring this back. Everyone needs to hear.
npc_reactions_confused: That's... that's music? I don't understand.
It's just sounds arranged oddly. Why is everyone crying?
I feel something but I don't know what it is.
Is it supposed to make me feel this way?
Everyone says it's beautiful but I just hear noise.
Maybe I'm broken. I don't feel what they feel.
The rhythm is... interesting. Not what I expected.
It's overwhelming. Too much sensation at once.
I need to hear it again. I need to understand.
Why would the old world need this? What purpose?

headlines: Strings of the Past: Pre-Silence Instrument Recovered
'Drums': Primitive Echo Generators Surface in Market
Scientific Analysis: How Did 'Violins' Create Sound?
npc_reactions: A guitar? They say you could make music with your hands.
I saw someone playing... making sounds from nothing.
The old world had hundreds of these... instruments.
Imagine creating Echoes yourself. Not just hearing them.
The Temple destroyed them all. Or tried to.
People used to learn to play. Spend years practicing.
It's not just hearing music - it's MAKING it.
What else did they take from us?
I touched one once. The strings vibrated. I felt it.
Some say the Resistance is teaching people to play.

headlines: Stranger Donates Rare Medicine to Dying Teen
{npc_name} Risks Life to Stop Armed Robbery
Community Rallies: {npc_name} Pulls Family from Floodwaters
Former Criminal {npc_name} Saves Temple Official's Life
Anonymous Hero Delivers Food to Undercity Orphans
Cyborg {npc_name} Uses Chrome to Save Trapped Workers
npc_reactions: Did you hear what {npc_name} did? Incredible.
There are still good people in this city.
Heroes exist. {npc_name} proved it.
They should give {npc_name} a medal. Or better housing.
Restores your faith in humanity, doesn't it?
We need more people like {npc_name}.
Reminds me there's more than just survival.
That took real courage. Most would have run.
The city isn't all darkness. Some light remains.
I hope I'd be that brave if it was me.

headlines: Former Worker {npc_name} Opens Own Shop After Years of Saving
Innovation: {business_name} Offers Unique Services to Area
Competition Heats Up as {business_name} Enters Market
npc_reactions: New place opened up. Might check it out.
Finally, somewhere decent in this neighborhood.
Competition's good. Maybe prices will drop.
I heard they're hiring. Might apply.
Hope they last. So many places close.
The food at {business_name} is actually edible.
Good for {npc_name}. Starting a business takes guts.
This area needed something like that.
Wonder how long before Temple takes their cut.
Another business means the area's improving. Maybe.

headlines: {npc_name} Family Denies Connection to Criminal Empire
Crime Boss {npc_name} Found Dead in Cell
npc_reactions: I knew {npc_name}. Never thought they'd end up like this.
{npc_name} arrested? About time. Everyone knew.
They're making an example of {npc_name}.
Innocent until proven guilty. Even {npc_name}.
The real criminals never get caught.
{npc_name}'s trial is just theatre.
I don't believe {npc_name} did it. Setup.
Justice? In this city? Please.
{npc_name} had it coming. We all knew.
Temple detention... that's basically a death sentence.

rumors._desc: Unconfirmed stories that spread among NPCs
echo_rumors: They say there's an Echo hidden somewhere in the Undercity.
I heard the resistance has a working music device.
Someone told me the Temple has vaults full of instruments.
A kid in {district} claims to hear music in their dreams.
The Prophet knows where the Echoes are. He's hiding them.
Before the Silence, everyone could make music. Everyone.
There's a frequency only some people can hear. Echo-sensitives.
Deep in the tunnels, you can still hear the old songs.
The corporate archives contain recordings. They just won't share.
Music didn't disappear. It was taken from us deliberately.
general_rumors: I heard {npc_name} is secretly working for the resistance.
They say the Spire has technology we can't even imagine.
Someone found a way out of the city. An escape route.
{district} is going to be quarantined. Heard it from someone.
The Temple is planning something big. Something soon.
There's a new drug that gives you Echo-like experiences.
Corporate is testing weapons in the Undercity. On people.
The Prophet isn't human. That's what some believe.
Credits are going to be worthless soon. Barter while you can.
A gang war is brewing. Big factions are choosing sides.
There are tunnels under the Temple. Ancient ones.
Someone important is going to be assassinated. Word is spreading.
The water in {district} isn't safe anymore.
A new faction is forming. Neither Temple nor resistance.
The AI in the core is becoming sentient. Or already is.

confirmation: I can confirm - I saw it myself.
This is real. My cousin works there.
It's not a rumor. I have proof.
Multiple sources are saying the same thing.
doubt: Just something I heard. Don't know if true.
Take it with a grain of salt.
Could be propaganda. Hard to tell.
Sounds too crazy to be real, but...
dismissal: I looked into it. Totally fake.
Someone's been drinking the wrong synth-brew.
